description: Look up CPSC NEISS product/activity codes by keyword, e.g. "pool", "ATV", "trampoline" — use this to find the exact product_code to pass to neiss_injuries, or just to see how CPSC categorizes a product. Entirely local (the fixed ~800-code NEISS coding-manual list); no live call.
